vo.en: Calculate these numbers in your head now.

visual.description: Close-up of a man concentrating intensely with focused eyes.

vo.en: Start with one thousand. Add forty. Add another thousand.

visual.description: Close-up of male hands quickly writing mathematical equations on paper.

vo.en: Quickly add thirty. Now add another thousand. Stay focused.

visual.description: Time-lapse of night highway traffic with fast light trails.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. Your brain is failing. Add twenty.

visual.description: Abstract digital static glitch effect on dark display.

vo.en: Add one thousand. Now add ten. What is your final number?

visual.description: Macro shot of a mechanical stopwatch rapidly ticking.

vo.en: If you said five thousand, you failed! The correct answer is forty-one hundred.

visual.description: Man looking shocked and shaking his head in confusion.

vo.en: Your brain took a lazy cognitive shortcut instead of doing simple addition.

visual.description: Glowing digital brain mesh animation processing data.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment FAIL if this tricked you, which is why you should

visual.description: Man holding smartphone and clicking screen with thumb.
